mechanisms.name: shearing of gamma-prime precipitates by dislocations

evidence.quote: Cyclic softening of Ni-based superalloys has been attributed to shearing of c0 precipitates,[12–19] while cyclic saturation has been attributed to bowing of c0 by dislocations.[13]

mechanisms.name: bowing of dislocations around gamma-prime precipitates

evidence.quote: Cyclic softening of Ni-based superalloys has been attributed to shearing of c0 precipitates,[12–19] while cyclic saturation has been attributed to bowing of c0 by dislocations.[13]
TEM studies of fatigued Ni-based alloys have shown convincingly that shearing of c0 precipitates is the dominant mechanism responsible for cyclic softening and slip localization in Ni-based alloys.
